latestVersion.changelog:
AI Subtitle Generator for Video — initial release!

- Instantly generate and burn-in subtitles for uploaded video files using a simple prompt.
- Supports fast upload, session management, and cloud-based processing with automatic token handling.
- Export captioned videos (up to 1080p) in multiple formats, including MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, and more.
- Offers quick status updates, session state tracking, and effortless management of subtitle languages.
- No export settings or timeline dragging required—just upload, describe your needs, and download within 30-90 seconds.
